visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One finally Instead of Repeated Cleanup
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The cleanup line is written in both the normal path and the catch block. Move it into a finally block. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: finally runs on every path out of the try statement, so the cleanup is written once. Duplicated cleanup is easy to forget when a new path (another catch, an early return) is added.
